query:
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_categories) as total_categories,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_categories WHERE parentId IS NULL) as main_categories,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_categories WHERE parentId IS NOT NULL) as sub_and_types;
